item.text: The cart currently calculates each line as price × quantity and has no discount logic. I’ll apply the 5% through `percent_of` at 10 units, so the discount rounds half up in cents, and verify both the line total and subtotal.

Lines with 10 or more units now receive 5% off, calculated with `percent_of` so rounding stays in integer cents. Added tests for the 10-unit threshold, subtotal, and half-up rounding.

`python -m pytest -q` passes: 23 tests.
